title: FairNet: Dynamic Fairness Correction without Performance Loss via Contrastive Conditional LoRA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) and Equalized Odds Difference (EOD) on the CelebA dataset (predicting the 'Male' attribute with 'Blond Hair' as a sensitive attribute) and the HateXplain dataset (measuring fairness metrics for hate speech detection targeting the 'Female' demographic).
Evaluating Demographic Parity (DP), Equal Opportunity (EOp), and Equalized Odds (EOD) on the HateXplain dataset for hate speech detection concerning the 'African American' demographic.

Measuring Worst-Group Accuracy (WGA) and Equalized Odds Difference (EOD) on the MultiNLI dataset based on the spurious correlation between negation cues (e.g., 'not', 'never') and specific entailment labels.
